analysis.session_summary: From Friday's close through Asia reopen, risk sentiment was the main swing factor: Trump/Iran headlines drove sharp two-way moves, while DXY closed +0.132% and SPX -0.409%. GBP and NZD led with strength +0.234% and +0.230%, while EUR and CHF lagged at -0.115% and -0.342%; USD/CHF rose 34.1 pips. ECB President Lagarde's remarks were muted (basket -0.028% inside noise floor), so no policy impulse from EUR. The tape is one of geopolitical risk-on/off impulses and no clean macro catalyst for most G10 pairs ahead of RBA and US data.

themes.theme: Geopolitical headline risk drove oil, havens, and high-beta FX
themes.evidence: Trump opposed Iran ceasefire at 23:00; later a US Official said positive discussion ongoing; Brent +1.769%, USD/CHF +0.412%, USD/MXN +0.87%, SPX -0.409%.

themes.theme: GBP and NZD strength, EUR and CHF weakness defined G10 cross tape
themes.evidence: GBP strength 0.234% and NZD 0.230%; EUR -0.115% and CHF -0.342%; GBP/CHF +0.576%, NZD/CHF +0.575%, EUR/USD -20.7 pips.

themes.theme: Central bank and verbal intervention had no durable impact
themes.evidence: ECB Lagarde basket -0.028% inside noise floor; BOJ minutes and Japan's Mimura headlines failed to own any leg; FOMC speakers not tied to moves.

currency_drivers.USD: No US catalyst; dollar held its range and gained modestly on geopolitical safety flows.
currency_drivers.EUR: Own Lagarde event was muted; EUR lagged, giving back an early +0.05% attempt.
currency_drivers.JPY: No clear catalyst; yen held its range despite verbal intervention headlines and large swings.
currency_drivers.GBP: No GBP catalyst; sterling led on broad demand and closed at its best.
currency_drivers.AUD: No domestic catalyst; early selling was rejected and recovered 89% into RBA risk.
currency_drivers.CAD: No Canadian catalyst; early +0.12% attempt was rejected and gave back 96%.
currency_drivers.CHF: No Swiss catalyst; franc was weakest, with early +0.13% attempt rejected and gave back 92%.
currency_drivers.NZD: No domestic catalyst; kiwi rallied from early -0.091% trough to close at its best.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD printed five two-way legs with the down legs (-24.2 and -33.2 pips) dominating three up legs (+10.2, +14.5, +14.5 pips), leaving it lower.

polarity_reads.read: Muted with basket -0.028% inside noise floor; no clean surprise, so EUR/GBP -4.99 sigma and EUR/USD -3.52 sigma are positioning noise rather than a policy signal.

scenarios.name: RBA hikes as expected but signals caution; US data misses soften USD
scenarios.thesis: RBA delivers 25bp to 4.60% but statement is less hawkish than feared; weak JOLTS/confidence pull USD lower and let AUD/NZD recover.
triggers: RBA statement data-dependent, no aggressive hawkish signal
US JOLTS below 7.23M or confidence below 90.1
scenarios.invalidation: RBA holds or signals aggressive tightening; US data beats.

pair_paths.rationale: USD softens on weak US data while EUR lacks own catalyst.
RBA hike delivered, short AUD squeeze after Friday's selling rejection.
Tracks AUD risk recovery; NZD closed at best and extends.
US yields fall on soft data; yen benefits.

scenarios.name: RBA disappoints and geopolitical risk premium returns; USD/CHF bid
scenarios.thesis: RBA either holds or delivers a dovish hike, triggering AUD downside; renewed Iran headlines lift oil and havens while strong US data supports dollar.
triggers: RBA cash rate below 4.60% or dovish statement
US JOLTS and confidence beat expectations
scenarios.invalidation: RBA hawkish, Iran de-escalation, US data weak.

pair_paths.rationale: RBA disappointment hits AUD; risk-off adds pressure.
Higher US yields and risk-off demand for USD.

scenarios.name: Iran de-escalation and broad risk-on unwind safe havens
scenarios.thesis: Positive Iran headlines and stable oil encourage carry demand; AUD/NZD and high-beta outperform while USD/CHF and USD/JPY fall.
scenarios.invalidation: Iran talks break down or US data very strong.

pair_paths.rationale: Risk-on and RBA hike supports AUD.
NZD closed at best and benefits from risk appetite.
Broad USD fall; EUR recovers modestly.
Yen strengthens as risk sentiment improves.

risks.watch: RBA Rate Statement and press conference at 06:30/07:30.

risks.why_it_matters: The tape was driven by these headlines; oil and haven CHF/JPY can reverse quickly.
USD rate expectations are sensitive; data may extend or reverse DXY +0.132%.

risks.why_it_matters: Legs were large with no clear catalyst; early week flows can produce outsized moves.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: RBA cash rate decision at 06:30 (4.60% forecast vs 4.35% prior) is the main event; Lagarde speaks again at 13:00, CAD GDP at 14:30, and US consumer confidence/JOLTS at 16:00 can shift USD and risk.
